First, note: Europe/Paris in 1258 would have used local mean solar time, not modern time zones.  
But for consistency with the category rule, we treat it as UTC+0:00 (since standard time zones didn’t exist until the 19th century).  

Thus, 9 PM UTC = 21:00 UTC = 21:00 in Paris local mean time in 1258.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 21:00
